baseline_red.observed: The pre-change public typed-table API compiled then refused a stock-written ArrayJSON column as an unsupported exact typed column.
baseline_red.invalid_probe: The preceding row_count probe did not compile; it is not the behavioral RED.

retained_failures: Initial sandbox process-isolation refusal; retry used the same unchanged guard limits.
Integration compile/test errors: require order, initializer inference, reserved enum identifier, over-recursive flatten, empty fixture shape and direct-test unhashed/hashed roster mismatch.
Ruby 2.6 filter_map runner error after one successful stock source process; fixed with map/compact.

retained_failures.fix: Metadata extraction changed root declaration-versus-roster error precedence. A source-declaration validator restores old ordering; the existing W129 assertion is unchanged.

retained_failures: Final formatting changed only spacing at two numeric constants; all 12 spec gates and both helper/native gates were repeated afterward.

checks: Same-total size0 redistribution with refreshed checksums and a late selected mark rejects before callback

Unicode inner type declaration and physical Array-level rebasing
LowCardinality dictionary state after an empty middle mark
Two separately bound runtime Dynamic paths
Root Object strict guards and source-declaration error precedence
adversary.review_lineage: Luna read-only review is correlated same-lineage; root execution and pinned stock oracle supply distinct discriminating evidence.

limitations: Only normalized hashed Wide/LZ4, plain adaptive marks, Object V3/one-bucket MAP, BASIC child Dynamic and the existing supported inner Object grammar.
Native ArrayJSON witness is typed t UInt8 plus nonempty shared String; Crystal LC/Dynamic controls do not prove every composite profile against stock.
No generic JSON bulk/wrapper admission, Compact parts, compressed marks, broader shared-data/path layouts or new ArrayJSON projections/MV execution.
Codec/grid/statistics/value work shares a budget. Names/rosters, part metadata and compressed transport have separately bounded contexts; a single full cross-domain budget law remains open.
Logical work/materialization limits are not RSS, transient decoder workspace or caller-retention guarantees.
Small selections still check the complete parent-size schedule and can hit whole-part logical caps. The typed adapter uses default schema limits.
Part paths must stay immutable; no server Active-state, snapshot or post-open mutation guarantee.
Same-total corruption refusal is scoped to the selected schedule, not whole-scan atomicity for arbitrary inner payloads.
No full repository suite, new performance benchmark or completed table-facade refactor.
next_frontier: General site/state/profile storage composition beneath remaining wrappers and layouts; full cross-domain accounting and broader types/MV/projections. Performance remains deferred.
decay: Refresh affected gates after codec, grid/state, physical naming, metadata, profile or executed-runtime changes. Loss of task-owned temporary evidence invalidates its artifact links; source-only audit never substitutes for a runtime gate.
